newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ECNZ in advanced negotiation to sell power station.
newsitem.headline: ECNZ in advanced negotiation to sell power station.

text.p: State-owned Electricity Corp of New Zealand said on Friday it was in advanced negotiations with Olivine New Zealand Ltd to sell the Meremere power station, north of Hamilton, and the nearby Meremere B site.
Meremere is a coal-fired 180 megawatt power station that was mothballed in March 1991 and put up for tender in November 1993.
ECNZ said it had signed a Heads of Agreement with Olivine and work was in progress to complete a sales and purchase agreement before the end of the year.
This in turn would initate a two-year option period during whihc Olivine would conduct due diligence.
